"Na kashe shi wallahi na kashe shi.

*MASARAUTAR KUDU*

_Haka zalika muna miƙa saƙon gaisuwa ta musamman da kuma godiya ga dukkanin waɗanda suka sayi littatafan mu na 'yan tagwaye biyar, mun yaba muku kuma mun jinjina muku Allah ya ƙara muku buɗi, lafiya da kuma daukaka, mun gode. Allah ya haɗamu a wata tafiyar cikin aminci_
